_comment: The 30 Hz chain with NOTHING pinned: no allowed_machines, no machine_width, every network free to take any aligned block of either cluster at any width the profile carries. The solver is told what the hardware can do -- smt.vmadot is legal only on cluster 0 (ModelBlaster/artifacts/ime_isa_probe/FINDINGS.md), and enable_impls offers each cluster-0 combination a second time costed from the ime_x60 profile -- and decides placement itself. Whether it puts perception on the P cluster to reach the matrix engine is then a result rather than an instruction. gen_root is gen_mb_shard_nav so fused_full's measured topo_0_1 and topo_0_1_2_3 tables are available; without them a wider nav is costed as one hart and the solver could not choose it even if it wanted to.

chain.deadline_rationale: a frame's goal reaches control within its nav window (77.8 ms); control is phase-locked at 100 Hz and acts on the newest goal
